_source.title: 设置属性状态：焊盘外形
_source.remarks.text.0: 设置焊盘外形时将会联动设置部分其它属性状态：
_source.remarks.text.1: 1. 特殊焊盘外形属性将被清空

title: Set the property state: pad shape
remarks.text.0: When setting the pad shape, some other property states will be set in conjunction:
remarks.text.1: 1. The special pad shape property will be cleared
